description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractStore' for key-value storage with synchronous and asynchronous methods, including documentation and example usage for various storage backends.

classes.name: AbstractStore
classes.description: An abstract class for implementing key-value storage with support for sync and async operations, operator overloading, and placeholder methods for storage backend implementations.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the store.

methods.name: async_exists
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check for key existence.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves key-value pairs for a given key, raises KeyError if not found.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores key-value pairs, replacing existing data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds entries matching filters, returns a generator.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns a list of all keys.
